nc.description: A 3D rendering displays a light grey mechanical assembly featuring gears, a belt drive, and a scissor linkage mechanism holding a white cylinder.
A close-up shows a light grey, articulated mechanical joint assembly with adjustment knobs against a white background.
A grey 3D rendering shows a mechanical assembly where a gear meshes with a linear rack designed to slide along cylindrical rods.
A 3D rendering displays a grey mechanical assembly featuring an articulated linkage, a central cylinder with a weighted pivoting arm, and a sliding block holding a vertical plate on parallel rails.
A faceted white central object is surrounded by grey cylinders and rings radiating outwards on a plain background.

vc.description: A grey mechanical device with spiked tracks and gears is ascending a steep slope, kicking up debris.
A static, monochromatic 3D rendering displays a mechanical assembly that includes a splined shaft, a universal joint, a disc brake, and a toothed belt and pulley.
A close-up shows a grey mechanical assembly featuring a toothed gear engaged by ratcheting pawls and secured with bolts.
An untextured 3D rendering displays a mechanical assembly of bicycle components, including a brake lever, cables, a chain, a disc brake, and a kickstand, attached to a central cylindrical tube.
A central mechanical assembly is surrounded by symmetrically arranged metal pipes and gears on a white background.
